comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll and reinstall its spring spindle; candidate screens media from finished washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial threading and two-end socket seating of a sprung spindle versus bimanual granular separation through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: New roll on spindle, both tips seated, empty tube removed, hands clear versus ≥98% media recovered and all washers retained with the screen safely reseated.
comparison.reason: This is constrained assembly and seating, not selective particle flow or agitation.
